name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
description: A dragon engine known as the Scourge of Kroog, which led Mishra's legions and later deemed Phyrexian invaders enemies too.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Traxos destroys the kingdom of Kroog during the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: The dragon engine known as the Scourge of Kroog earned its name when it destroyed the kingdom of Kroog during the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
